answer: Score identity by the carbon intensity of its actual consumption: smart-meter readings weighted by grid intensity over a month produce a footprint only a real household can show, with daily rhythms and seasonal shifts. A farm of fake accounts sharing one meter would show identical intensity curves, and the delta between claimed and metered use exposes the copy. The whisper of hourly readings, the orchard of varied household loads and the delta of the score together make bulk fakery visible.
